related_issues.reason: Same setup (UV_CACHE_DIR placed inside the project tree) but a different symptom and root cause: uv appropriates the project version for dependencies. Labelled external. Useful context, not the same problem.

rationale: The reporter cites #19991 as the cause, but search_issues returned no hit for it, so I could not read it and did not list it as a duplicate. The uv GitLab integration guide (docs/guides/integration/gitlab.md) explicitly recommends UV_CACHE_DIR: .uv-cache inside the project, so a hard error from uv build in that documented configuration contradicts uv's own documented pattern, which supports bug over question. The build backend is not the cause as described, so this is not external. Not a documentation-only issue because the failure is uv's behaviour, not the wording. Confidence is medium because the duplicate target #19991 was not verifiable and the exact error text is not quoted.
